why: Alexander Zheglov posted arXiv:2410.06959 claiming a proof that the Dixmier conjecture holds for the first Weyl algebra (updated Jan 2026); separately, a July 2026 counterexample to the Jacobian conjecture in three variables (credited to Claude Fable 5, per Terence Tao's blog) implies the generalized Dixmier conjecture is false for the n-th Weyl algebra for all n≥3.

found.title: The Conjecture of Dixmier for the first Weyl algebra is true
found.note: Preprint by Alexander Zheglov claiming a proof for the n=1 case; latest version dated Jan 2026; not read.

found.title: A digestion of the Jacobian conjecture counterexample
found.note: Blog post discussing a 3-variable Jacobian conjecture counterexample credited to Claude Fable 5, which implies falsity of the generalized Dixmier conjecture for n≥3; not read in full.
